walkthroughs.body_html:
This topic is part of the Edexcel GCSE Astronomy specification.

Exploring the Solar System appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Exploring the Solar System in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The Edexcel board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Exploring the Solar System.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
